notes.title: Bride for the Princess Full Release!
notes.notes:
Our latest Visual Novel has left Early Access and is now a full release!

It'll have a special launch discount of -15% off the full price. We hope that you'll enjoy playing it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144550/Bride_for_the_Princess/

We also have released Digital Artbook

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1429860

You may also get them together on a Special Edition.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16263

notes.title: Trancevania and Version 1.12
notes.notes:
Halloween is almost upon us. To celebrate this ocassion, we have launched Trancevania addon,which features a new playable character and a small new dungeon. The DLC will be -10% cheaper all the way until the end of the Halloween.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/732190/Strangers_of_Power__Trancevania/

Chandra the fourth heroine

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30218695/5bb0a941244aaabdc8433787124e30c007899f54.png

Chandra is a vampire. She has no interest in saving the town of Serina and has simply come for personal reasons that are to find her missing sister, after hearing a rumor that she was in the castle. She has unique blood magic and fights using dual wielded weapons such as swords or axes. If she gets hurt, she can use a powerful blood frenzy attacks.

Version 1.12

Bugfix

Weapon Master couldn't be talked to from a certain angle, this has been fixed

Bows now have 5% increase in crit rate

Bugfix

The Innkeeper's name would stay on screen when sleeping at inn, this has been fixed

Loading now only happens at the start of the game, also eliminating some lag and FPS issues

Graphics

Changed the cursor in the character select screen
Cleaned up the kissing image a bit
Made the Inn more uniform in height

Gameplay

Removed reduntant Formation option to free more space in menus
Removed reduntant Window color options to free more space
Moved Fullscreen option to General and removed Display element in Options

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30218695/3d3762f2e9fab7424ef53d4976022b0e92a5200c.png
Balance

Lowered initial WIS of Gracie to 2 (was 3)
Lowered the base damage of Fire Barrage to 4 (was 5)
Lowered the base damage of Bolt to 4 (was 5)
Lowered the base damage of Chill to 4 (was 5)
Lowered the base damage of Blizzard to 8 (was 10)
Lowered the base damage of Immolate to 8 (was 10)
Lowered the base damage of Thunder Storm to 8 (was 10)
Increased SPI of Bats to 2 (was 1)
Increased HP of Zombies to 15 (was 14)
Increased SPI of Zombies to 2 (was 1)
Increased SPI of Golems to 2 (was 1)
Increased SPI of Spiders to 3 (was 1)
Increased HP of Lamias to 20 (was 18)
Increased DEF of Lamias to 5 (was 4)
Increased HP of Snakes to 25 (was 22)
Increased SPI of Snakes to 3 (was 1)
Increased DEF of Minotaur to 15 (was 13)
Increased SPI of UniBunnys to 4 (was 1)
Increased HP of Unibunnys to 40 (was 36)
Increased SPI of Mimics to 3 (was 1)
Increased SPI of Killer Plants to 4 (was 1)
Increased HP of Morgan to 250 (was 200)
Increased ATK of Morgan to 25 (was 24)
Increased DEF of Morgan to 15 (was 14)
Increased SPI of Lost Warriors to 8 (was 1)
Increased HP of Madam Blueberry to 600 (was 500)
Blindness now decreases Accuracy by 85% (was 50%)
Blindness now decreases Evasion by 30% (was 0)
Using Protect now increases defense of the user by 200% for the duration of protection
Spell enchantment now gives smaller buff to WIS
Removed Maiya's flare skill

Bugfix

You could walk on lava in Cat Queen cave, this has been fixed
Maiya's ending had her called wrong name, this has been fixed

Gameplay

Made changes to Steal formula.
Stealing from enemy who has armor or weapon, decreases their DEF, ATK, etc. for the value of the item stolen.
Succesfully stealing grants a temporary buff based on item stolen for 5 turns
Changed critical formulas to better account for luck
NEW GAME ONLY - Maiya now has a new move "Sneak Attack" which deals damage based on her AGI and how many times she has succesfully stolen from foes
Magic shopkeeper now only comments on player's magical skills first time

Graphical

Magic shopkeeper now has bust portrait
